title: Locker Rental: daily-use rental terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, whether that tier may be rented by the day rather than monthly, the fee for a single day's use, and the maximum number of consecutive days a daily-use rental may run before a monthly rental would be required instead. The rule governing how a tier permitting daily use is actually charged, as against a tier billed monthly, is a separate handling matter and is not restated here.

## Daily-use table
| Tier | Daily use allowed | Daily use fee | Maximum consecutive daily-use days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | No | not applicable | not applicable |
| Medium Locker | No | not applicable | not applicable |
| Large Locker | No | not applicable | not applicable |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | No | not applicable | not applicable |
| Day-Use Locker | Yes | $3.00 per day | 5 consecutive days |
| VIP Locker Suite | No | not applicable | not applicable |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- Which tier may be rented by the day? Only the Day-Use Locker.
- What is the daily fee for that tier? Three dollars per day used.
- For how many consecutive days may a Day-Use Locker be used before a monthly rental would instead be required? Five consecutive days.

## Points of judgement
Daily use is fixed as not allowed for every tier other than the Day-Use Locker; for those other tiers, the daily use fee and the maximum consecutive daily-use days are fixed as not applicable, since a tier where daily use is not allowed has no daily rate or daily-use ceiling to state.
